name: @rue-js/runtime-vapor
description: Rue JavaScript runtime backed by a Rust/WebAssembly reactive graph kernel
author: Xiangmin Liu

scripts.build-profiling: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --profiling --target bundler --out-dir pkg-vapor --no-default-features --features dev --features log && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-dev: node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-vapor --no-default-features --features dev --features log && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build: npm run build-ts && node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-vapor --no-default-features && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-vapor: npm run build-ts && node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target bundler --out-dir pkg-vapor --no-default-features && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.build-node: npm run build-ts && node ./scripts/run-wasm-pack.mjs build --release --target nodejs --out-dir pkg-node --no-default-features --features log --features dev && npm run cleanup-wasm-pack
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check-ts && npm run build && npm run build-node
scripts.prepack: npm run check-ts && npm run build && npm run build-node
